alert.title: Encoded PowerShell command on a production server
alert.description: powershell.exe was launched with an encoded command line (-EncodedCommand) on srv-prd-app01, a production server in the PCI zone. The parent process was cfgagent.exe running as SYSTEM.

hits.title: Configuration management on production Windows servers
hits.excerpt: Production Windows servers are managed by the Contoso configuration agent, cfgagent.exe, installed under C:\Program Files\Contoso\ConfigAgent and running as SYSTEM under the ContosoConfigAgent service. It applies state by launching powershell.exe with -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -EncodedCommand, so an encoded command whose parent is cfgagent.exe from that path, as SYSTEM, inside a declared maintenance window, is the expected shape of a run and the agent doing its job. Document the exception on the triplet (device, parent image path, account) in the detection's exclusions for that server; do not disable the rule, since an encoded command from any other parent, from any other path, as any other account, or outside a window is exactly what it exists to catch.

hits.title: Change calendar: CHG0042117
hits.excerpt: CHG0042117, standard change, approved. srv-prd-app01: IIS application pool recycling drift correction (PaymentsApi), applied by configuration management. Maintenance window 2026-09-14 02:00 to 04:00 UTC. Owner platform-ops@contoso.com.

arguments.summary: The alert triggered on an encoded PowerShell command launched by the internal configuration agent (cfgagent.exe) as SYSTEM on srv-prd-app01. Decoding the command reveals routine administrative activity (IIS app pool recycling configuration update and restart for PaymentsApi). Furthermore, this execution occurred precisely within an approved change window (CHG0042117). The detection logic functioned correctly in flagging encoded PowerShell, but the activity is entirely authorized and benign.
arguments.recommended_action: Close the alert as a benign true positive and add an exclusion or annotation for the legitimate configuration agent (cfgagent.exe) on srv-prd-app01 during approved maintenance windows.
